name: No-spend month
summary: Run a no-spend month with daily check-ins, swap ideas for the categories you choose and an end-of-month review.

onboarding.prompt: When does your no-spend month start?
onboarding.reaction: Day one is on the calendar.

onboarding.prompt: What spending is still allowed (bills, groceries, gas)?
What will you do with the money you keep?
onboarding.reaction: Love a purpose. It shows up on hard days.

onboarding.prompt: Tap an evening time for a 30-second check-in.
onboarding.reaction: Check-in set. Tap yes or no each night.

phases.name: The month
actions: Swap ideas for each off-limits category

plan_blueprint.calendar: A nightly 30-second check-in at the chosen slot, a weekly mini review, and an end-of-month review session.

approach_variants.habit: Nightly check-in tied to an existing routine; no-spend streak.
approach_variants.willpower: 30-day challenge with dares from partners for free fun.
approach_variants.time: Free activities planned as calendar blocks for weekends.
approach_variants.reward: Part of the money kept goes to an owner-chosen reward at the end.
approach_variants.resource: Prep week gathers free options: library, parks, recipes from the pantry.

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Essentials like food, medicine, rent and bills are never off-limits.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A spend day is logged privately and the month continues; there is no reset. Three spend days in a row prompt a quick check on whether the rules need adjusting.
